title: The test operation reads a scalar under the non-specific tag as a string
notes: `! 12` is the string "12" (Example 6.28), so testing it against the string succeeds and the patch goes on to the replace. The tagged scalar's own bytes do not change.

provenance.reference: A reader that resolved a scalar under the non-specific tag by its text, so `! 12` was read as an integer.
